whyItMatters: tarfile.extractall extracts python archives without name checks, so traversal entries write outside the target directory.
actions: Check every entry name with per-entry name validation, rejecting absolute paths, .. segments, and symlinks.
Extract into an empty directory and verify its contents before use.
Re-run the scan and confirm extraction is guarded.
verification: Rescan shows extraction guarded, and a traversal-entry archive writes nothing outside its directory.
